paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Associate role on Strategy&'s Business Model Reinvention team. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Helping a business rethink how it makes money is the part of strategy I find most interesting, because it forces you to tie the big idea back to the numbers.

At Lenovo I spent two years as a Senior Business Analyst building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and running variance and sensitivity analysis on budget reallocation so leadership could see the tradeoffs. At JPMorgan I benchmarked marketing-channel budget allocations against peers and found 30% efficiency gains that shaped where the money went next.

That is the same muscle a reinvention project needs: breaking a business into its parts, testing options with real numbers, and walking senior people through what changes and why. My MBA work in valuation and corporate finance adds to that. I'd welcome the chance to talk about the team.
